scope.object: Immutable retained executable versions of prompt/tool/workflow configurations; also task data and, under D/H/M, task-model parameters. GVO separately trains Drafter LoRA, Scorer and Policy between complete searches.
scope.feedback: Observed real checks under fixed uneditable contract Gamma determine adoption and completed-search training returns. Learned continuation predictions guide allocation but do not supply required evidence.
scope.retention: Complete admissible successor artifacts persist across held-out tasks and Carry rounds; Reset/Same-start studies isolate learned improver from retained task artifact. Cross-backbone transfer freezes the Qwen-trained improver.
scope.weights: D+H freezes the task model but allows non-test data and Harness edits. D/H/M permits joint task-model and Harness edits. Improver parameters are trained between searches in both settings.
scope.limit: Include the actual agent-Harness and joint-edit branches. Scientific controllers/physics-model calibration and task-output code are not all agent Harness. D+H is not a pure Harness-only ablation and shared improver-training does not make every task a coevolution result.

limits: This is source-bound scope/version review and arithmetic over displayed values, not reproduction of experiments, raw seed logs, code, model training, or online supplements.

Only accepted output requires complete admissible evidence; draft parents may be incomplete. Root inclusion makes in-search improvement nonnegative by construction; this does not prove unseen-task gain or indefinite acceleration.
D+H permits non-test data. Separately trained improver and D/H/M model edits must be explicit; cannot describe the whole method as a permanently frozen model or Harness-only intervention.

Default lambda=mu=0 means hard constraints and cost features without a soft cost penalty. Exact replay rho=1 means clipping does not bound the actual single-step update; absence of gradient-norm clipping matters.
Core direct checks, optional checked reuse, predictor diagnostics, and actual evidence are separate. Fixed verification contract is not a learned or evolving ground-truth judge.

Call budgets140/130/160/135/120 are matched across scientific methods, but matching call count does not establish full training/search/evaluation cost equality. Failed complete-suite calls count; cached/proxy calls do not.

Five paired seed means, three searches per seed by default, with different cohorts across figures. Pointwise intervals and frozen-transfer comparisons do not prove universal reliability; held-out losses must remain visible.
20-round cumulative gains carry changing task roots and cannot be read as a single final benchmark accuracy improvement of42.1 pp.
Scientific optimization artifacts and csvstat taskcode are external products; only documented persistent agent configurations justify Harness membership.
Current canonical v1 and historical decisions stay unchanged until separate version-metadata and public-summary review. Neither this review nor a primary consensus auto-adopts v2.
